column6: SEI bullet overstated: interfaces "often control cycle life and safety more than any bulk property"; softened to "strongly affect ... often as much as bulk properties do"
timeline put integration/encapsulation at "days"; it takes weeks; cell arrival widened to minutes to hours

sintering bullet absolute "only liquid-phase sintering uses a molten additive" (liquid need not come from an additive; viscous sintering also exists); reworded as a separate variant where a small amount of liquid forms
iso-stress is a lower bound and real transverse modulus sits somewhat above it; "follows" judged an acceptable approximation, left
carrier bullet stated carriers "are polarons and bipolarons" with no qualifier; trans-polyacetylene (the How example) also has solitons; added "usually" and the soliton case
exercise asked to link "each glide or screw axis" to absences for Fm-3m, whose symbol has none; its absences come from F centering; added lattice centering
LaMer plot is strictly monomer concentration; "precursor concentration" matches the file's older question explanation, left

exercise fails when worked: Pb-Sn is a eutectic with separate alpha, beta and liquid G curves, so it has no spinodal points; split into common tangents for Pb-Sn plus a separate miscibility-gap curve for the spinodal
silicon bullet credited its lead "largely" to manufacturing and passivation, omitting its near-optimal 1.1 eV gap and abundance; added both

records are often measured on single crystals in one direction overstated (most record ZT values are polycrystalline; SnSe is the single-crystal case); reworded to peak values at one high temperature, sometimes single crystals
